# Swift Web Sync

> Swift Web Sync is a digital engineering agency specializing in high-performance, mobile-first static web applications and edge infrastructure for US small businesses, including restaurants, salons, home contractors, and fitness studios. We replace slow, generic template platforms with lightning-fast, secure static architectures.

## Core Entity Profile
- **Organization Name:** Swift Web Sync
- **Primary Website:** https://www.swiftwebsync.com
- **Contact Email:** contact@swiftwebsync.com
- **Service Territory:** United States (Nationwide)
- **Primary Specializations:** Static site architecture, Jekyll, SCSS, Vanilla JavaScript, mobile-first UI/UX engineering, and edge network hosting.

## Business Model & Pricing Structure
- **Zero-Risk Prototype Preview:** We build and deliver a fully functional, custom live mobile prototype preview for prospective clients within 24 to 48 hours—completely free before financial commitment.
- **Build Milestone Pricing:** $500 total build fee structured as a 50% deposit ($250) upon agreement and 50% final launch balance ($250) upon prototype approval and domain deployment.
- **Managed Retainer:** $49/month covering high-speed cloud edge hosting, SSL certificates, DNS maintenance, and regular code/content updates.
